summary: Innovation Labs Fall 2025, hosted by MAIC in collaboration with Xorbix Technologies and Databricks, brought together 180+ students from MSOE, Rose-Hulman, Pasadena City College, UWM, and Marquette to build AI-powered solutions for real industry challenges. Qual-V took first place for their product defect detection work using ML evaluations and Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback.
title: Innovation Labs Fall 2025 Finals with Xorbix & Databricks
